reason: A more directly addresses corrosion resistance in steels through the established Cr-rich passive-film mechanism and proposes a composition-matched grain-size comparison with measurable film and corrosion outcomes. Its broad grouping of aqueous and molten-salt regimes weakens it, but B neither isolates passivation from the generic barrier effect of a coating nor adequately reconciles cited evidence that laser-deposited HEA coatings contained cracks and suffered corrosion damage.
